the rER and hER genes are both transcribed from two promoters (B and C in rER; A and B in hER), but that promoter B is the only one that is active in all tissues in both species.

the rat and the human ER gene have a very similar promoter organization.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the rER and hER genes are more similar than previously thought, and the existence of a promoter A in the rER is highly unlikely.
